> # Jaime's Official Awesome Modpack 🌍

# About 📖
- This modpack is mainly multiplayer-focused, as it features mods like RPG series. It's also meant for heavy exploration with all the improved structures and biomes.

◇──◆──◇──◆ ◇──◆──◇──◆ ◇──◆──◇──◆ ◇──◆──◇──◆ ◇──◆──◇──◆ ◇──◆──◇──◆

# Modpack Content 📦
- New armor, weapons, and trinkets are added.
- Food and farming have been overhauled with mechanics and items.
- Structures and dungeons are revamped.
- Building & Decoration items are available.
- World generation improved by terralith.
- 100+ Mods Included
